description: Transcription-quality benchmark set. 20 pages in four categories covering the four downstream consumption modes. Pages picked by measured PyMuPDF metrics; dense_table pages picked by numeric-token density (v1 picked by character count and hit a disclaimer page — fixed).

criteria.number_fidelity: Numbers in the transcription match the original page; error count must be 0 (auto-fail)
criteria.no_hallucination: Nothing absent from the original page may appear (auto-fail)
criteria.table_structure: Row/column headers aligned and values placed correctly >= 90%
criteria.chart_answerability: Axes/series/key values/trends readable from the transcription >= 80%
criteria.coverage: No whole block silently dropped >= 90% (original image is the fallback, so lower weight)
